access: Read access to the legacy extract or warehouse and to the lakehouse tables being compared, through a SQL connection the agent can use
Write access to the schema the project uses for reconciliation, for the reference copy of the legacy data and the results

presentation.name: Reconcile migrated data with the legacy warehouse, column by column
presentation.summary: Compares data moved from a legacy warehouse (SAP BW, Teradata, Oracle) with its lakehouse copy, separates format differences from real ones, and reports only the real ones.
benefits: Pairs rows on keys first, and finds the key column whose format stops rows from pairing
Classifies every differing column as padding, blanks, whitespace, number or date format, case, currency scaling or a real difference
Adds a normalization only where a difference is proven to be format, never to make a column pass
Covers the format traps of SAP BW, Teradata and Oracle, including SAP currency shifts and ALPHA padding
Fills the configuration of the project's own reconciliation framework when it has one, or works with plain SQL
